limitations: Warm cache only; no cold-cache, HDD, SMB or NFS timings.

macOS uses 25,000 files per shape and the hosted CI build profile (LTO=false, codegen-units=16), not the Windows/Linux 1M-file profile (thin LTO, codegen-units=1).
Compare variants within a row only. These results do not rank operating systems, machines or competing tools.
io_uring is an optional Linux build feature. Main install instructions do not enable this optional feature.
Raw MFT microbenchmarks are excluded from this end-to-end CLI table.
